name: Abdallah Ramadan
bio:
Hello, my name is Abdallah Ramadan. I’m a Computer Science student at Helwan University, and I’ve always been passionate about technology, problem solving, sharing knowledge and helping others. Back in high school, I was a mentor in both the Math and Physics clubs, where I provided over 35 weekly sessions in calculus, algebra, and physics concepts. I guided and taught around 45 sophomore students, designing problem sets and assignments to prepare them for national and international competitions. Many of the students I trained went on to place in the top 3 ranks in Egypt in contests like Purple Comet and Physics Brawl and won medals in IAAC and IYMC.
Also, I cofounded the EGYPT2USA community on Discord which now includes 2000+ Egyptian students applying to US and international universities. I helped organize Q&A sessions, shared scholarship and resources for writing essays, and personally guided many of those students through the application and financial aid process.
Currently, I’m focusing more on the AI field. I joined the Digital Egypt Pioneers Initiative (DEPI) in the AI & Data Science track, where I’ve been learning about machine learning, data analysis, data engineering and developing and building practical applications of AI. It’s been a great opportunity to build solid foundations in both theory and practice. At the same time, I’ve started my research journey in AI and machine learning. Right now, I’m working on a literature review titled "Real Time Toxicity Speech Detection for Online Gaming Environments" under the supervision of one of my professors. This experience has given me a taste of what real research feels like digging into academic papers, comparing methods, and identifying gaps that can be improved.
In conclusion, my experiences in mentoring, community leadership, and now research have shaped me into someone who not only learns but also shares and supports others. I believe these skills, mentoring, reviewing content, coordinating with teams, and exploring AI research, make me ready to take on the responsibilities of Vice Head of the CS & AI field in El Tafawok Union.

Through my participation, I was able to learn skills such as effective communication with people, scheduling appointments, and working as a team. I volunteered on the coaching committee for NASA Space Apps Qena, which was held annually for the first time, and on the scientific research committee for a team specific to my department at the university.
I also volunteered in several volunteer activities. Some were very useful, while others were not the best, but these experiences taught me how to choose the right place and team to contribute my efforts. I participated as a team leader in a project for a competition organized by the Geno Academy team.
Through my volunteering, I learned how to organize communication between people and maintain a positive atmosphere. This encouraged me to become a Community Moderator to help with organization and ensure the participation is beneficial for everyone. I have a great passion and interest in scientific research, and I want to develop myself in this field. One of my goals is to work on myself well until I can obtain a scholarship, God willing. I love to learn continuously and strive to be committed to everything I do to achieve the best possible results. By volunteering in the Union 𝐄𝐥𝐭𝐚𝐟𝐚𝐰𝐨𝐤 Team, I hope to be a factor, however small, in benefiting others while simultaneously learning and developing myself .
